# Start with the comparison {#findings}

This fixture uses synthetic figures solely to test the skill. It is not investment advice or a forecast. The visual priority is comparison: the reader should see the scale of the change before reading its explanation.

A useful evidence-led document separates results from interpretation. The figure is the evidence; the surrounding text explains what it means and where the limits remain. Short findings can use a compact grid, while the chart spans the available page width.

```metrics
Baseline | 120 | synthetic units
Pilot | 156 | synthetic units
Change | 30% | illustrative only
```

```chart bar
title: Synthetic quarterly activity
Q1 | 120

```

## The decision

Continue the smaller pilot while collecting a full cycle of comparable observations. The change is useful enough to investigate, but the fixture does not establish causality. The next document should report the conditions of measurement alongside the results.
